sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (true = $1 or true = $2 or true = $3 or true = $4)

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (true = $1 or true = $2 or true = $3 or true = $4) order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $5 offset $6
